aboutText: With years of experience serving Maidstone and Melbourne's west, Fresh Vent Cleaners specialises in thorough AC cleaning to ensure healthier air and efficient cooling. Our team is dedicated to providing meticulous service, as highlighted by our satisfied customers. We use professional techniques to remove dirt, mould, and allergens from your air conditioning systems.
servicesText: From comprehensive AC system cleaning to mould removal, we provide a range of services to keep your air conditioning in top condition. Our team ensures efficient operation and improved air quality for homes and businesses in Maidstone.

services.title: AC System Cleaning
services.desc: Our expert AC system cleaning service involves a deep clean of all components to remove dust, dirt, and debris, ensuring optimal performance and energy efficiency for your home.

services.title: Vent and Duct Cleaning
services.desc: We specialise in vent and duct cleaning to eliminate accumulated grime, allergens, and contaminants, promoting cleaner air circulation throughout your property in Maidstone.

services.title: Air Filter Replacement
services.desc: Regular air filter replacement is crucial for maintaining air quality; we provide high-quality filters and professional installation to keep your AC running smoothly.

services.title: Mould Removal
services.desc: Our mould removal services target harmful growth in vents and AC units, using safe and effective methods to restore a healthy environment for your family.

services.title: AC Maintenance
services.desc: We offer comprehensive AC maintenance checks to prevent breakdowns, extend the lifespan of your system, and ensure it operates at peak efficiency all year round.

services.title: Indoor Air Quality Inspection
services.desc: Our indoor air quality inspection service assesses your home's air, identifies issues, and provides solutions to improve health and comfort for Maidstone residents.
